project.name: virtual-cv-portfolio
project.description: Executive Virtual CV Portfolio for Principal Data Scientist & ML Architect

stack.frontend: Vanilla JS (ES6+), Vanilla CSS (Custom Properties), HTML5 Semantic
stack.integrations: Google Calendar API (Service Account JWT Auth)
stack.tooling: Zero-dependency local HTTP preview (serve.js) & static distribution builder (build.js)

brainstorming.purpose: Explores user intent, enforces hard approval gates before code modifications, classifies tasks (Spike, Bounded, Architectural), and prevents unexamined assumptions.

hallmark.purpose: Enforces structural variety, locked CSS custom properties, roman upright display typography, honest engineering copy, and strict multi-breakpoint mobile responsiveness (320px-1200px).

react-spring-physics.purpose: Supplies natural spring mechanics (mass, tension, friction), interruptible gestures, momentum damping, and velocity-aware micro-interactions translated to performant vanilla CSS/JS.

ui-ux-pro-max.purpose: Provides searchable local guidance across 119 UX rules, 192 product color palettes, 74 font pairings, touch target ergonomics (≥44px), WCAG AA contrast (≥4.5:1), and accessible form states.

ui_designer.role: Lead UI/UX Designer & Design Systems Engineer

orchestration_pipeline.deliverable: Classified requirement path (Spike/Bounded/Architectural), technical design, and approval gate.
Design tokens, anti-slop visual hierarchy, responsive layout verification (320px-1200px).
60fps hardware-accelerated transforms, spring curves, canvas vector loop optimizations.
Serverless routes, Google Calendar integration, error boundaries, and form feedback UX.
Production build execution (npm run build), bundle verification, zero dead code check.

quality_gates.zero_dead_code: No orphaned CSS selectors, unused CDN libraries, or ghost DOM elements allowed.
quality_gates.token_discipline: All colors, fonts, and spaces must consume CSS custom properties defined in :root.
quality_gates.performance: GPU-accelerated animations (transform/opacity only); canvas paused when tab is hidden.
quality_gates.accessibility: WCAG AA color contrast (≥ 4.5:1), touch targets ≥ 44x44px, keyboard navigation supported.
quality_gates.build_cleanliness: Static build into dist/ must execute cleanly and generate 100% reproducible artifacts.
